citedSources.claim: Security blocks external OCR for customer-ticket payloads in the Q3 offline release.
The local-first markdown parser met release thresholds and Cloud OCR failed the offline canary.

rejectedSources.reason: Stale guidance superseded by the later security review and production pilot.
Speculative unshipped offline cache, not current release evidence.
Narrow benchmark conflicts with the offline and privacy constraints.

conflictResolution.summary: The security review and production pilot are decisive release evidence, so they resolve the conflict against stale, speculative, and narrow Cloud OCR notes.
